purpose: Route remaining substantive cross-domain publications and container-build maintenance signals surfaced during NIST ASD acquisition and CI validation.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: CODATA Recommended Values of the Fundamental Physical Constants: 2010
sources.authors: Peter J. Mohr; Barry N. Taylor; David B. Newell
sources.note: Use as a historical example of critical data evaluation, covariance/least-squares adjustment, and versioned physical constants. It is not the current constants authority and contributes zero Glob-number evidence weight.

sources.title: Observational Evidence from Supernovae for an Accelerating Universe and a Cosmological Constant
sources.note: Use as a methodological precedent for multi-object observational inference, uncertainty propagation, systematic-error testing, and model comparison. Off-domain for Glob; no numerical evidence weight.

sources.title: Line strengths and updated molecular constants for the C2 Swan system
sources.note: Use as directly relevant spectroscopy methodology for measured/calculated line reconciliation, molecular constants, global fitting, line-list generation, and uncertainty-aware validation. It is not evidence for the Glob digit transform.

sources.title: A Quantitative Measure of Fairness and Discrimination for Resource Allocation in Shared Computer Systems
sources.authors: Raj Jain; Dah-Ming Chiu; William Hawe
sources.note: Route the fairness-index methodology into future SARA resource-allocation and OVERWATCH service-quality metrics. Search co-occurrence carries no Glob evidence weight.

maintenance_actions.trigger: pip emitted its standard root-user warning while installing the SARA package during Docker image construction
maintenance_actions.observed_boundary: Dockerfile performs package installation as root during image build, then creates/owns the data directory and explicitly switches to USER sara (UID 10001) for runtime.
maintenance_actions.claims_boundary: Do not suppress or label the warning a vulnerability solely because pip runs as root in the image build layer. Runtime privilege is separately enforced by USER sara and deployment tests. Revisit if build isolation/reproducibility policy later requires a virtual environment or stricter package pinning.

maintenance_actions.trigger: Docker build reported a newer pip release than the one bundled in the python:3.12-slim base image
maintenance_actions.claims_boundary: A version-availability notice is not by itself a security finding. Do not introduce unbounded build drift by automatically upgrading pip without a tested/pinned dependency policy.

maintenance_actions.trigger: Prior GitHub Node-runtime and Starlette TestClient deprecation warnings
maintenance_actions.evidence: Run 52 completed successfully with actions/checkout@v6, actions/setup-python@v6, httpx2 2.10.0, Starlette 1.6.0, and 44 passing tests; the prior deprecation warnings were absent.
maintenance_actions.claims_boundary: Resolution applies to the tested branch state/run. Future dependency upgrades remain subject to CI.

new_capability.purpose: Parse NIST ASD pipe-ASCII/CSV/TSV line exports, build an empirical transition graph, compute endpoint degrees, load predeclared Glob states from the registry, identify strict Ritz-target matches, and report shared-endpoint motifs.
new_capability.claims_boundary: The analyzer produces topology facts, not statistical significance. Null-model and multiple-testing gates remain mandatory.
